summary: Verified bug fix for landing page 'Não foi possível carregar configurações' error toast. Root cause was /app/frontend/public/env-config.js hardcoding window._env_.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to a different fork's URL (credito-app-12), which took precedence over process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in env.js. After correction to this fork's URL, backend endpoint /api/configuracoes/landing returns 200, frontend loads landing page cleanly with Kredor branding, no error toast, and no page/console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: env-config.js is a runtime-injected config file (regenerated by docker-entrypoint.sh in production from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Hardcoding an actual fork URL into the source-controlled version is fragile — recommend either committing a placeholder like 'REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL_PLACEHOLDER' or having env.js prefer process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL when window._env_ contains the placeholder, to avoid cross-fork breakage when repositories are cloned.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing page (/) and public endpoint /api/configuracoes/landing are working. env-config.js now points to this fork's URL. If cloning to a new fork in future, remember to update /app/frontend/public/env-config.js window._env_.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
rca of the issue: Root cause: /app/frontend/public/env-config.js set window._env_.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to https://gestorcred-preview-2.preview.emergentagent.com (another fork). env.js prioritizes window._env_ over process.env, so axios called the wrong backend, triggering CORS/network failure and the error toast on LandingPage.js useEffect catch. Mitigation: updated env-config.js to this fork's URL. Verified via curl (200 OK) and Playwright (no toast, Kredor content renders, 3 successful /api/configuracoes/landing calls with status 200).
